a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting to reach 8 cells will most likely leave us both with nothing. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know this departs from our agreement, so I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If we both get through the storms, I'll operate with you afterwards so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
